title: indexnow check --json
description: The report of the check command of every indexnowkit adapter (indexnow:check --json, php yii indexnow/check --json). `status` is the worst level of the report; `--strict` changes the exit code, not the status. Items are in the order the command prints them; group by `host` on your side when you need a per-host view. Codes are the API (core docs/check-codes.md); messages are for humans and change between versions.

status.description: error when any item is an error, else warning when any item is a warning, else ok

environment.description: the configured `environment` (APP_ENV / INDEXNOW_ENV / the framework's environment), null when none is known or the configuration did not build

code.description: the stable identifier of the check (key_file.status, debounce.store, queue.connection; config.invalid when the configuration did not build); null only for an application check that names none

message.description: the human line, as printed without --json; not API

host.description: the host the line is about (key file, probe), null for global lines
